Documentation

Get started with the Vectoris SDK and REST API.

Installation

pip install vectoris-sdk

Quick Start

from vectoris import Client, IndexConfig

client = Client(api_key="your_api_key")
index = client.create_index(
    name="docs",
    dimensions=768,
    metric="cosine",
    index_type="hnsw"
)

# Upsert vectors
index.upsert([
    {"id": "1", "vector": [...], "metadata": {"source": "wiki"}},
])

# Query
results = index.query(vector=[...], top_k=10)
print(results)

API Reference

POST /v1/indexes

Create a new vector index with specified dimensions and index type.

POST /v1/indexes/{id}/upsert

Insert or update vectors in batch. Supports up to 10,000 vectors per request.

POST /v1/indexes/{id}/query

ANN similarity search with optional metadata filters and hybrid sparse-dense fusion.

DELETE /v1/indexes/{id}/vectors

Delete vectors by ID without index rebuild.

Index Configuration

IndexConfig(
    index_type="hnsw",      # hnsw | ivf_pq | exact
    dimensions=768,
    metric="cosine",        # cosine | euclidean | dot
    hnsw_m=16,
    hnsw_ef_construction=200,
    pq_subvectors=8,
)

Multi-Modal Embeddings

Vectoris supports unified embedding pipelines for text, image, code, and audio modalities. Use the embedding API to generate vectors before upserting to your index.

embedding = client.embed(
    input="Your document text",
    model="vectoris-embed-v1",
    modality="text"
)
